Wir suchen

Du möchtest nicht nur Pipelines betreiben, sondern komplette Betriebs- und Deploymentplattformen gestalten? Du möchtest Verantwortung für produktive Kundenumgebungen übernehmen und moderne DevOps-Praktiken vom Build bis zum Rollout umsetzen?
Dann werde Teil unseres Application Management Services Teams.
Wir betreiben und entwickeln für unsere eitco Lösungen im Umfeld der gesetzlichen Unfallversicherung moderne DevOps-Plattformen und unterstützen unsere Kunden beim Betrieb, führen Rollouts durch und übernehmen den Third-Level-Support. Dabei setzen wir konsequent auf Automatisierung, Infrastructure as Code und GitOps.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Umsetzung und Optimierung automatisierter Build-, Test- und Deployment-Prozesse
  • Entwicklung eigener Puppet-Module und Automatisierungslösungen
  • Durchführung von Rollouts in Kundenumgebungen
  • Unterstützung bei Architektur- und Betriebsfragen unserer Entwicklungsteams
  • Analyse und Behebung komplexer Betriebsstörungen im Third-Level-Support
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Monitoring-, Logging- und Observability-Lösungen
  • Mitarbeit bei Betrie

jobs.title: Senior Fleet Coordinator - Kfz-Technik & Fahrzeugmanagement (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Your Role

Als Senior Fleet Coordinator (m/w/x) im Bereich Active Fleet bist du ein zentraler Treiber unserer Customer Experience und stellst sicher, dass unsere Kund:innen jederzeit sicher und mobil auf den Straßen unterwegs sind. Mit deinem ausgeprägten Service- und Prozessdenken steuerst du operative Abläufe im Fahrzeug- und Reparaturmanagement und hebst unsere Servicequalität auf das nächste Level. Durch deine proaktive Arbeitsweise optimierst und automatisierst du Schnittstellen, um das Wachstum unserer Flotte nahtlos zu unterstützen.


Your Mission

  • Exzellente Mobilitätsabsicherung garantieren: Du steuerst und koordinierst eigenverantwortlich Service-, Reparatur- und Pannenfälle und stellst in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren externen Schadenmanagement-Partnern eine schnelle, reibungslose Abwicklung für unsere Kund:innen sicher.

  • Flottenverfügbarkeit maximieren: Du behältst die Einhaltung aller gesetzlichen und herstellerspezifischen Fristen (wie Wartungen und Inspektionen) im Blick und optimierst die Auslastung sowie den Zustand unserer gesamten Flotte

We’re searching for a Senior Graphic Designer to redefine how the world’s leading crypto media brand looks and feels as we evolve into an institutional-grade financial intelligence platform. Your Mission

EV charging is evolving from a niche technology into everyday infrastructure. As reev grows, teams increasingly need reliable, consistently defined metrics. Today, different dashboards, reporting dates, filters, and assumptions can produce different answers to the same business question.

We are a deep-tech startup on a mission to fundamentally change how we treat the world's most valuable resource: water. This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Brand Protection Specialist (SEO) based in Germany.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in protecting a global digital brand and its intellectual property across search engines and online channels.
You will monitor the web for unauthorized content, investigate potential infringements, and coordinate effective enforcement actions.
The role sits at the intersection of SEO, digital brand protection, copyright, and online compliance.
You will work closely with Legal, Marketing, and SEO stakeholders to identify threats and protect branded search visibility.
The position offers a high degree of ownership, requiring strong research skills and the ability to independently resolve complex online cases.
You will collaborate with external platforms and service providers, including domain registrars, hosting companies, and web-security providers.
This fully remote role is well suited to a detail-oriented, proactive professional who enjoys investigative work in a fast-paced international environment.

Working fully remotely within a global team, you’ll have meaningful ownership in a fast-growing technology environment.

jobs.title: (Senior) Applied Scientist, Recommendations
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Wolt is part of DoorDash - together we form one of the world's largest local commerce platforms. We build recommendation systems that help customers discover the most relevant restaurants, dishes and items throughout their Wolt experience.

We are looking for an Applied Scientist to advance the machine learning models behind these experiences.

jobs.description:
Forward Deployed Engineers turn what Luma's models can do into systems customers actually rely on. You embed with a customer, learn their workflow, define the problem with them, and build the production system that solves it, with their data and their constraints. You own both the relationship and the code.

This is engineering at the edge, where ambiguity is the default and "what should we build?" is yours to answer. It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. If you need a PRD and a well-defined ticket queue, this isn't it.
